_about: Season-aware preventive timing notes by disease-driver category. Generic, conservative guidance only; it never changes the diagnosis. review_status: draft_needs_expert_review

fungal_humid.kharif: Monsoon humidity and leaf wetness favour rapid fungal spread: scout fields within 1-2 days after rain, keep drainage clear and avoid overhead irrigation.
fungal_humid.rabi: Cool nights with dew or fog can still trigger infection: inspect lower leaves on foggy mornings and irrigate in the morning so foliage dries by evening.
fungal_humid.zaid: Hot dry weather usually slows spread, but irrigated plots stay at risk: keep foliage dry and remove infected leaves promptly.

bacterial.kharif: Rain splash spreads bacteria: avoid working in wet fields and disinfect tools between plots.
bacterial.rabi: Spread slows in cooler, drier weather; still avoid handling wet plants and use clean seed/transplants.
bacterial.zaid: Limit sprinkler irrigation, which splashes bacteria between plants.

vector_borne_crop.kharif: Insect vector populations rise with warmth and humidity: monitor whiteflies/aphids closely and remove infected plants early.
vector_borne_crop.rabi: Vector activity is usually lower; remove infected plants before the next warm season to cut the source of spread.
vector_borne_crop.zaid: Warm dry spells favour whiteflies and aphids: use yellow sticky traps and remove weed hosts around the field.

vector_borne_livestock.kharif: Biting flies and mosquitoes peak in the monsoon: remove standing water, control vectors around sheds and isolate affected animals.
vector_borne_livestock.rabi: Vector pressure is lower, but keep affected animals isolated and report cases to the veterinary officer.
vector_borne_livestock.zaid: Keep sheds clean and dry to reduce flies; isolate affected animals.

contagious_livestock.kharif: Wet, crowded conditions aid spread: restrict animal movement, disinfect sheds and report to the local veterinary officer.
contagious_livestock.rabi: Cold stress can lower immunity: keep animals sheltered, restrict movement and report suspected cases.
contagious_livestock.zaid: Avoid shared water points and markets during outbreaks; report suspected cases.

heat.kharif: Humid heat reduces cooling: ensure shade, ventilation and constant clean drinking water.
heat.rabi: Heat stress is uncommon now; re-check the temperature and look for fever or infection instead.
heat.zaid: Peak heat season: provide shade, cool water several times a day and avoid work in midday heat.

nutrient.kharif: Heavy rain can leach nutrients: apply fertiliser in split doses after a soil test.
nutrient.rabi: Plan fertiliser at sowing based on a soil test; cold soils can slow nutrient uptake.
nutrient.zaid: Irrigate before top-dressing so nutrients reach the roots.

pest.kharif: Pest populations build quickly in warm humid weather: scout weekly and use pheromone/sticky traps.
pest.rabi: Pest pressure is often lower; keep scouting and destroy crop residues.
pest.zaid: Hot dry weather favours mites: scout leaf undersides and maintain adequate irrigation.

livestock_management.kharif: Keep bedding and udders clean and dry during the wet season.
livestock_management.rabi: Maintain balanced feeding through the cold season and monitor intake.
livestock_management.zaid: Ensure enough water and shade; heat can reduce feed intake.

healthy.kharif: No disease detected. The monsoon is high-risk for most diseases, so keep checking every few days.
healthy.rabi: No disease detected. Continue routine weekly checks.
healthy.zaid: No disease detected. Watch for heat and water stress.
